dataset_name: MoleculeIQ PubMed Relevance Annotations (Excerpt-Free Public Release)
description: Excerpt-free benchmark annotations containing query associations, relevance grades, and sentence SHA-256 hashes. Sentence text is reconstructed deterministically from locally hydrated PubMed abstracts via split_into_sentences() and verified against sentence_hash_sha256.
